request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:RAIDER

layers.text: Change only the rider's clothes and the blanket: the red bandana becomes a warm mid-brown leather cap; take off the red tunic so his chest, belly and arms are bare olive green skin, with one mid-brown leather strap across the chest and a mid-brown leather loincloth; the red saddle blanket becomes warm mid-brown stitched hide with a dark brown edge. Chestnut brown, not orange, not red. Keep the grey wolf, the goblin's face, ears, spear, pose, proportions, black outline and art style the same.
